review.tagline: Python and Cython NLP library with pretrained pipelines for 70+ languages
review.summary: spaCy is a Python/Cython library for tokenization, tagging, dependency parsing, named entity recognition, text classification, lemmatization and entity linking. It ships pretrained pipelines installed as Python packages and a config-driven training system, and can use transformers such as BERT or custom PyTorch and TensorFlow models. LLMs can be added to pipelines through a documented integration.
review.audience: Python developers building production NLP pipelines (NER, classification)
strengths: Pretrained pipelines install as ordinary Python packages via `python -m spacy download`
Tokenization and training support for 70+ languages
Built-in training system, model packaging, and syntax and NER visualizers
Extensible with custom components; accepts PyTorch and TensorFlow models
weaknesses: Models may need re-downloading or retraining after spaCy upgrades
Library only; no model server or HTTP API included
Support is public only (GitHub, Stack Overflow); no individual email support
needs: Models: spaCy pretrained pipelines, transformers (BERT), PyTorch, TensorFlow, word vectors
